steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Well, well, you actually came to us Browntails' territory for a visit all by your lonesome. You got balls, Gnosis Edelweiss.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I've always been upright and honorable.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph, that's rich coming from you after you were kicked out of Karlan Trade for your shady business.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I thought I'd see Ratatos here.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Anyone could bluff like that. Ratatos wasn't going to just take your word so easily.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As I said before, it takes two to cooperate. It seems my words have reached her, and that's more than enough to me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph, talk all you want.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So, since you came here all by yourself... You said last time 'things have come to this.' What's that all about?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What things have come to what?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why do you think Enciodes proposed this transfer of powers?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph, isn't that because he can't take on both the Paleroches and us, and so he figured to compromise?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Compromise?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hoh, compromise.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Think again, Madame Sciurus. I dare say that your sister thinks otherwise.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Ever since Enciodes came back to Kjerag, was there any single thing he did that wasn't in pursuit of his ultimate victory? Is his proposal to put the Saintess back in power really a compromise?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Here's a hint—The Ceremony.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hm...? What about the Ceremony? Don't tell me he's going to throw a fit there and refuse to turn over his powers.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The Ceremony is nigh, and there will be more trains coming in and out of the Silverashes' territory transporting both resources and people.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Take a guess, why did Enciodes himself propose to hand the Saintess his powers, even arranging for it to happen on the day of the Ceremony?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Arctosz's a short-sighted man. He thinks Enciodes will pull some kind of dirty trick once she's in control.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: And so he reassigned his men to guard the valleys and the mines, even to keep an eye on the Doctor that Enciodes invited.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But the funny thing is that he doesn't know it's all pointless!
Sciurus looks to a corner of the room for a brief moment. There is nothing there, but Gnosis notices it.
Gnosis looks straight at the wall there.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Ratatos, you can't be that stupid.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I will tell you what Enciodes is planning.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But you'd better see me yourself next time.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Even if I have to see his schemes come to fruition and you two imprisoned—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I won't allow myself be made a fool of again.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Now excuse me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hey, Ratatos! I know you're there!

steps.name: Wallboards
steps.text: Pipe down, Sciurus.
There is a rumbling noise, and the wallboard slowly moves to the side. Ratatos, sitting inside, slowly rises and steps out.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You believe in what he said?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Maybe I should say I'm shocked that you never considered the possibility, sister.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But even the Saintess is on our side now!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Can Enciodes really be so unscrupulous that he...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That he...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Don't be silly, Sciurus.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: From the moment he first trampled our faith, when he laid his train tracks straight to Kjerag and broke away from the Saintess...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: No, ever since he so calmly agreed to let his sister become the Saintess in exchange for his seat in the Tri-Clan Council, he hasn't cared.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: We all know how well those siblings got along in their earlier years. I also once thought that letting the devout Enya become the Vine-Bead Court's hostage was a brilliant move.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But now? Hmph, I wouldn't be surprised if he one day brought his men up the mountain to burn down the whole Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Don't tell me Enciodes is really going to use force...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Slow down, sister.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: There's another possibility. He could be pulling our leg.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: To make us think he's up to something shady so we end up making the first move.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What good does that do him?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If he's not trying to have somebody else do his dirty work and off his enemies, he's trying to find an excuse to start a war and earn himself some clout in the end.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hmph, whatever it is, we're probably all in trouble.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: How do we figure this out?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: No idea.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: None at all?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'm not exactly omniscient here.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But if he's lying, there's got to be holes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Your orders, Matriarch?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Dig up anything you can find on Gnosis. We looked into him before, but he's had lots of dealings since his job got handed off. There should be a lot more clues now. Start there.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You'd better not disappoint me, Gnosis Edelweiss.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos... If he was telling the truth, would you really take him in?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: He's an Edelweiss! The family who got Enciodes's father killed fifteen years ago!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: They betrayed the Silverashes, but when Enciodes came back from studying in Victoria, this guy tagged along, wanting a slice of the pie.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If you ask me, he's the type who doesn't give two licks about loyalty, only profit and success. Now that he's made an enemy of his master, he's got to find a new sugar daddy to get his revenge.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Right, that's the most obvious reason.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So you...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus... 'The Silverashes control the gates, the Paleroches have their rich farmlands and their army, but the Browntails have nothing. Why do you think we stand as one of Kjerag's three families?'

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: '...Because what we do earns the highest return.'

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I learned Grandpa's lessons just as well as you did.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Right, since I'm letting you in, there are lots of things that you really must spend some time pondering.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: As a child of the Browntails, in times like these, you need to know the best course of action. It's more than just knowing the risks of dealing with a criminal. You need to learn to assess all this yourself.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Profit always comes with risks. We need to learn how to mitigate these risks beyond just shutting them out along with the profits, dear sister.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Our biggest worry is that everything he just said was true, but also part of a lie.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Another thing.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You've gotten really close with that servant of yours, haven't you?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You mean Monch?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Monch, conch, gonch, whatever.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Don't trust anyone too much, sister.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Grr, I don't need you to tell me what to do!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'll show you how much stronger I can make Browntails without you!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *Sigh*... I should never have given Enciodes this chance.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I have that braindead moron Arctosz to thank. Take Enya away from her scumbag brother? Don't make me laugh.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Whatever. Yucatan.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Yes, Matriarch?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Let the Paleroches know that I'll visit in a few days.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Doctor, we've entered the valley.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Sorry... Sir Arctosz never permitted any rail tracks to be built in the Paleroches' territory, and it's not in our habit to use cars.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I suppose it may not be easy for a foreigner like you to ride a burdenbeast.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, welcome. I am Sir Enciodes's secretary, Chester.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Please allow me to accompany you as you survey the area.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: To give Sir Arctosz the absolute peace of mind, we'll ask you to inspect each and every factory and mine site before they're declared closed.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Once you have checked everything here, both Sir Arctosz and the Great Elder will give their approval. Only then will the transfer be considered complete.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: What do you think, General Valais?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: That would be for the best, of course.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: In that case, please follow me. We'll take stroll and get a grasp of the environment and situation here.

steps.name: Senior Subject
steps.text: Still, this is just way too sudden...

steps.name: Young Subject
steps.text: Right, I had heard there was bad news from the last Tri-Clan Council. But that's not enough to send us running.

steps.name: Senior Subject
steps.text: My son was hurt while working in the factory not too long ago. I'm still waiting for his medical subsidy.

steps.name: Senior Subject
steps.text: We... We've always believed in Sir Enciodes! He's not going to abandon us, is he?

steps.name: Young Subject
steps.text: All of us put in so much work to improve the Kjerag's livelihood. He can't just shut the factory down like that!

steps.name: Infected Subject
steps.text: What about Infected like us? We finally found work at the factory...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Please, everyone, calm down. Listen to me—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Oh, nice timing, Doctor.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It's been a while. I'm really sorry that we dragged you into our local affairs.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Please bear with it for a little longer. Once the Ceremony is over, the Silverashes will properly receive you.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But, before that, I think I might need your help with something.

options: You want me to help calm these people down?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sharp as always, Doctor.

options: Looks like you're doing well yourself.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Don't be so humble, Doctor. Your abilities are on another level. I've seen for myself.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And we'll need your help with many other things as well.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Well then, I'll need to borrow the Doctor for this job of mine. Just for a bit. Would the Paleroches mind?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Friends and countrymen, Sir Enciodes has personally instructed me to offer all those affected an explanation on his behalf.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It so happens that the Doctor is here too. The Doctor is Sir Enciodes's esteemed guest, and Karlan Trade's current chief technical officer.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Today, together with all of you, our guest will bear witness to this message:

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: At the Tri-Clan Council, the great houses and the Vine-Bead Court reached an understanding for the interim, and will begin discussion on any follow-up matters.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Because of the grave mistakes made by Gnosis, the previous CTO, Karlan Trade must shut down all of its factories in a show of goodwill.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Once the transfer of powers is complete, the Silverash family will actively work with the Vine-Bead Court and advocate for a gradual reopening of some of our factories in a controlled, carefully-planned manner.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Please trust me and trust the Silverash family that this is for the best.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Now, as I introduced earlier, and will emphasize once more, this is Sir Enciodes's esteemed guest as well as Karlan Trade's current CTO.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Our guest is a master not only of the production and mining technologies that we are all familiar with, but also the prevention and treatment of Oripathy.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The Doctor likewise represents a medical organization that will help Karlan Trade answer the critical questions that we are all struggling with, including the medical support issue we were just discussing.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Such things would not be possible in our mountains of yore, and, together with the Doctor, Karlan Trade will bring about this new future.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: At the same time, it is Sir Enciodes's wish for the territorial subjects of the other two houses to cast aside their differences and help us build Kjerag.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There is no need for panic. Please put your faith in Sir Enciodes and the Saintess. Have faith that Kjeragandr will never abandon Her children.

steps.name: Senior Subject
steps.text: Aah, by Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Young Subject
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Now then, I will...

steps.name: Infected Subject
steps.text: Wait! Hold on a minute!

steps.name: Infected Subject
steps.text: After hearing you out... I-I have something to say!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Please.

steps.name: Infected Subject
steps.text: It's not that we don't trust the other two houses.

steps.name: Infected Subject
steps.text: It's just we've really had it fairly nice the last couple years thanks to Sir Enciodes. We have work, we get enough food to eat, and we even get painkillers.

steps.name: Infected Subject
steps.text: We never had it so easy before...

steps.name: Infected Subject
steps.text: Since we heard the factory was going to be shut down, we've all been worried that the good times are coming to an end...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Please rest assured.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The Doctor, as I introduced just now, is an Oripathy scholar. Karlan Trade invited the Doctor here precisely because we are concerned about our Infected workforce's livelihood.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: So please put your faith in us, Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes, is there something you would like to add, Doctor?

options: I was told Mr. Enciodes is more practical.
Trust alone isn't going to keep anyone fed.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There are also those of the mind that his ideas are impractical.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: My apologies. I have misspoken.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: *Sigh*... Very well. Looks like I'm not going to fool you, Doctor.

steps.name: Senior Subject
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: So merciless, Doctor.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Friends, it's true. I am not done yet.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We didn't keep our internal affairs in check, and that led to you losing your jobs. That is entirely our fault.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Karlan Trade promises to keep your original positions unfilled. You will continue to be compensated, and we will arrange job opportunities with equal or even greater pay and benefits.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And I am sure you can already tell that, unlike Gnosis, the Doctor actually understands what you truly need.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The Doctor will bring Karlan Trade the technologies that will truly benefit our day-to-day lives.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Right, this is what Sir Enciodes truly wanted all of us to know!

steps.name: Young Subject
steps.text: Sound great! I'll head back and let everybody know!

steps.name: Senior Subject
steps.text: Good, that's very good, but don't forget Kjeragandr's teachings, young man...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Not at all. It's my job to speak for him.

options: Is that the help you wanted?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But I'm sure you'll agree that this was worth helping?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Okay, Doctor... I'll take you out for some fondue. My treat.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Not at all, Doctor.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Actually, if it wasn't for you, I probably would've forgotten to say all that.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Okay, I will take my leave now.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes?

options: You can't be here just for that.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'm not sure what you are talking about, Doctor.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: All the requirements have been met, just as Madame Sciurus expected.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Enciodes sent Weiss presumably as some kind of insurance policy.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: But that's not nearly enough.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: You are to ensure that things go according to Madame Sciurus's plans once Weiss is gone.

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You were followed.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: What?! I didn't...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: There was only one of them, now long gone, running after the men Sciurus assigned to you.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I'm very sorry for betraying your expectations, Sir Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: No, perhaps this is for the better.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I'm prepared to be your pawn and to do whatever you say.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm just a researcher, Monch.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Pawns are meaningless to me. What I want is a partner that I can work with.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Proceed with the plan. Don't worry. Ratatos and Sciurus won't catch you.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Understood.
